hints.title: Precomputing Match Matrices
hints.text: Precompute the compatibility score between every student i and mentor j as the count of identical answers.

hints.title: Bitmask of Assigned Mentors
hints.text: Use an integer bitmask where the j-th bit represents whether mentor j has already been matched to a student.

hints.title: Dynamic Transition Over Students
hints.text: For student index matching the number of set bits in mask, assign any unallocated mentor j and recurse.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: M: count of students and mentors (at most 8)
complexity.notes: Bitmask dynamic programming assigning one student per set bit count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all M! mentor permutations tests up to 8! = 40,320 permutations repeatedly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since M <= 8, 2^M = 256 states cache overlapping subproblems.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize assignment matching via bitmask memoization.

solutions.approach: Bitmask DP with memoization in Python 3
